rods.name: Bamboo Rod
rods.description: A simple bamboo pole. Gets the job done.

rods.name: Driftwood Staff
rods.description: Heavy and slow, but the wide tip gives you a more forgiving catch window.

rods.name: Fiberglass Rod
rods.description: Lighter than bamboo with a wider tip. Gives you a more forgiving catch window.

rods.name: Reef Guard
rods.description: Responsive and fast. Bites come a little quicker than the baseline.

rods.name: Telescoping Rod
rods.description: Extends deep. Something about the length draws rarer fish to the surface.

rods.name: Moonwood Staff
rods.description: Carved from driftwood blessed by a full moon. Quicker bites and a wider catch window.

rods.name: Graphite Rod
rods.description: Lightweight and stiff. Noticeably quicker bites.

rods.name: Navigator's Rod
rods.description: A well-balanced deep-sea rod. Good speed and a wider catch zone.

rods.name: Carbon Rod
rods.description: Precision-engineered for quick, snappy bites.

rods.name: Deep Diver
rods.description: Built for the abyss. Fast bites and a wide catch window.

rods.name: Legendary Rod
rods.description: Forged from the mast of a sunken galleon. Faster bites, and the rarest fish cannot resist.

rods.name: Twin-Strike
rods.description: Two hooks on one line. When luck strikes, they both bite.

rods.name: Second Wind
rods.description: Stubborn rod. When you miss, sometimes it refuses to let go.

rods.name: Millionaire's Rod
rods.description: Hand-rolled in gold leaf. Every catch brings two.

rods.name: YOLO Rod
rods.description: Roll the dice every cast for a 100-fish haul — and the odds climb the shallower you fish. The rest of the time? Just a regular catch.

rods.name: Completionist Rod
rods.description: Forged from the soul of every species in the sea. A master's tool on its own, and a vessel besides: fit up to three rods you own into it to carry their gifts, and re-forge whenever you like.

rods.name: Treasure Rod
rods.description: Lures the deep’s lost hoards — doubles your chance of hooking a crate.

rods.name: Perfect Rod
rods.description: Rewards flawless form — perfect catches grant double XP, and it scales with your streak.

rods.name: Galaxy Rod
rods.description: Spun from cosmic thread. After any catch, open a wormhole and reroll it into a different fish from the same waters — fortune or folly, you take what surfaces.

rods.name: Lightsaber Rod
rods.description: A blade of pure energy. Fish are drawn to the light — most casts bite almost the instant your line touches the water.

rods.name: Yoon's Locked-In Rod
rods.description: Rewards a hot hand. Chain perfect catches to LOCK IN: 3 in a row quickens your bites, 5 lands a triple haul on every catch, and 10 quickens them further into a rare-fish frenzy. Hold the streak to keep it all — one miss and you start over.

baits.name: Worms
baits.description: Reliable all-purpose bait. Claim 20 free from your Daily Bonus.

baits.name: Night Crawler
baits.description: Fish bite 15% faster. Widens your catch zone by 4° — a bigger catch zone means more room to land the needle.

baits.name: Angler's Formula
baits.description: Fish bite 35% faster. Widens your catch zone by 8° — a bigger catch zone means more room to land the needle.

baits.name: Luminous Lure
baits.description: Fish bite 40% faster and the catch zone widens by 10°. Earned from expeditions and bounties, or bought with Fathoms in the Locker. Something ancient stirs when it glows.
baits.hint: Something ancient stirs when it glows.

baits.name: Golden Lure
baits.description: Fish bite 45% faster. Widens your catch zone by 10°. The finest lure in existence — a rare drop, or bought with Fathoms in the Locker. The oldest things in the deep rise for its shine.
baits.hint: The oldest things in the deep rise for its shine.

lines.name: Copolymer
lines.description: Blended nylon. More give, less break.

lines.name: Titanium Wire
lines.description: Near-zero stretch. Cuts through current like nothing.

lines.name: Deep Sea Line
lines.description: Built for the abyss. Almost nothing breaks it.

anglersPatience.unlock: Double the chance of hooking a crate
